player_prompt.intro:
I ye {role} kɔnɔ Colonel Blotto.
Jɛɲɔ ye ka mara caman na jɛɲɔɔ.
Kɔnɔ kɔnɔ, sɔrɔ {num_total_units} uniti kɔfɛ {field_names}.
Mɔgɔ min sɔrɔ uniti caman na kɔfɛ kɛlɛ, ɔ kɛlɛ kɔfɛ, mɔgɔ min kɛlɛ kɔfɛ caman na mara.
Nin ye misali, '[A7 B7 C6]' sɔrɔ 7 uniti A, 7 B, ani 6 C.
